name: All Lending Club loan data, accepted loans 2007 to 2018 Q4
kept_in_repo: No. The file is about 1.3 GB in its download, so data/prepare.py turns it into the small files here.
summaries: status_counts.csv, by_vintage.csv and by_band.csv are exact totals across all 2,260,668 loans.
sample: loan_sample.csv.gz is a fixed random sample of 200,000 loans (seed 42), used for the model.
